rules.statement: A part-owner of a land is entitled to use it for taking carts to his house which is on the land, provided, by doing so, he does not interfere with the enjoyment of the land by his co-owners.
rules.supporting_quote: It seems to me that the plaintiff has misconceived his action, and that the issues tried did not cover the actual facts of the case. It seems to me an elementary principle that the part-owner of a land is entitled to use it for taking carts to his house which is on the land, provided, by doing ,so, he does not interfere with the enjoyment of the land by his co-owners.
